title: Register, login, and fetch current user
description: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid tenant/user details expects 201. POST /api/v1/auth/login with the same credentials expects 200 with JWT access token and refresh-token cookie. GET /api/v1/auth/me with the access token expects 200 with the current user profile.

title: Reject invalid login credentials
description: POST /api/v1/auth/login with a wrong password expects 401. POST /api/v1/auth/refresh without a valid refresh-token cookie expects 401.

title: Logout invalidates the session
description: POST /api/v1/auth/logout with a valid access token expects 200. A subsequent GET /api/v1/auth/sessions with the same token should no longer list the revoked session.

title: Auth endpoints enforce rate limiting
description: Repeated POST /api/v1/auth/login attempts beyond the configured threshold (10 req/60s) should eventually receive 429 Too Many Requests.

title: List and manage roles and permissions
description: GET /api/v1/access-control/permission-groups and GET /api/v1/access-control/roles expect 200. POST /api/v1/access-control/roles with a valid payload expects 201. PATCH /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/permissions/:permissionKey expects 200 with updated permission.

title: Access control rejects unknown role and insufficient privilege
description: GET /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/permissions for a non-existent roleId expects 404. DELETE /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/permissions/:permissionKey using a low-privilege token expects 403.

title: Reset role permissions to defaults
description: POST /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/reset with a valid admin token expects 200 and permissions restored to the default set. GET /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/users expects 200 with assigned users.

title: Branch CRUD lifecycle
description: POST /api/v1/branches creates a branch (201). GET /api/v1/branches lists it (200). PATCH /api/v1/branches/:id updates it (200). DELETE /api/v1/branches/:id removes it and a subsequent GET /api/v1/branches/:id returns 404.

title: Create item with variant and look up its barcode
description: POST /api/v1/items creates an item (201). POST /api/v1/items/:itemId/variants creates a variant (201). GET /api/v1/item-barcodes/lookup/:barcode returns matching item/variant details (200) once a barcode is attached.

title: Item and barcode lookups handle not-found cases
description: GET /api/v1/items/:id for a missing item expects 404. GET /api/v1/item-barcodes/lookup/:barcode for an unknown barcode expects 404 or an empty result.

title: Create category, brand, and unit reference records
description: POST /api/v1/categories, POST /api/v1/brands, and POST /api/v1/units with valid payloads each expect 201 with the created reference record.

title: Inventory adjustment full lifecycle
description: GET /api/v1/inventory/stock/levels expects 200. POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments creates a draft/pending adjustment (201). POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/:id/approve approves it (200). POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/:id/post posts it and stock updates (200).

title: Stock transfer full lifecycle
description: POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers creates a transfer between warehouses (201). POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers/:id/approve approves it (200). POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers/:id/dispatch dispatches it (200). POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers/:id/receive receives it and reconciles stock (200).

title: Reject transfer received before dispatch
description: POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers/:id/receive called on a transfer that has not been dispatched should return 409 (invalid transfer state).

title: Stock count session lifecycle
description: POST /api/v1/inventory/counts creates a count session (201). PATCH /api/v1/inventory/counts/:id/items/:itemId saves a counted quantity (200). POST /api/v1/inventory/counts/:id/finalize finalizes the count and returns a report (200).

title: Reorder points and expiring batches reporting
description: GET /api/v1/inventory/reorder-points/below-minimum returns low-stock items (200). GET /api/v1/inventory/reports/expiring-batches returns the expiring batch list (200).

title: Adjustment approval on non-existent record
description: POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/:id/approve for a non-existent adjustment id expects 404.

title: Purchase request to purchase order approval flow
description: POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-requests creates a request (201). POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders referencing it creates a draft PO (201). POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders/:id/submit submits it (200). POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders/:id/approve approves it (200).

title: Purchase order invalid-state transitions are rejected
description: POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders/:id/reject on an already-approved order expects 409. POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders/:id/cancel on a completed order expects 409.

title: RFQ to award to purchase order generation
description: POST /api/v1/purchasing/rfqs creates an RFQ (201). POST /api/v1/purchasing/rfqs/:id/send sends it to suppliers (200). POST /api/v1/purchasing/awards creates an award from a winning quote (201). POST /api/v1/purchasing/awards/:id/create-purchase-orders generates purchase orders (200).

title: Goods receipt posting updates inventory
description: POST /api/v1/purchasing/goods-receipts creates a goods receipt (201). POST /api/v1/purchasing/goods-receipts/:id/post posts it and updates inventory (200).

title: Supplier profile stats and amendment validation
description: GET /api/v1/purchasing/suppliers/:id/profile-stats for an unknown supplier expects 404. POST /api/v1/purchasing/amendments with an invalid source document reference expects 400.

title: Open shift, create invoice, view invoice detail
description: POST /api/v1/shifts/open expects 200. POST /api/v1/invoices with valid cart and payment data creates an invoice (201). GET /api/v1/invoices/:id returns invoice details (200).

title: Hold, list, and toggle visibility of held orders
description: POST /api/v1/invoices/held creates a held invoice (201). GET /api/v1/invoices/held lists it (200). PATCH /api/v1/invoices/held/:id/visibility toggles visibility (200).

title: Cancel an invoice and verify status
description: PATCH /api/v1/invoices/:id/cancel on a cancellable invoice expects 200. GET /api/v1/invoices/:id afterward shows the cancelled status.

title: Invalid invoice payload and closed-shift close are rejected
description: POST /api/v1/invoices with invalid/incomplete cart data expects 400. POST /api/v1/shifts/:id/close on an already-closed shift expects 409.

title: Create customer and view history/stats
description: POST /api/v1/customers creates a customer (201). GET /api/v1/customers/:id/history returns purchase history (200). GET /api/v1/customers/stats returns metrics (200).

title: Customer not found and invalid custom field schema
description: GET /api/v1/customers/:id for an unknown id expects 404. POST /api/v1/customer-field-definitions with an invalid field schema expects 400.

title: Check in and check out attendance
description: POST /api/v1/attendance/check-in expects 200. GET /api/v1/attendance/me shows the current attendance summary (200). POST /api/v1/attendance/check-out expects 200.

title: Attendance exception created for geofence violation
description: POST /api/v1/attendance/check-in from outside the configured employee geofence expects a 403 or exception-required response. POST /api/v1/attendance/exceptions with exception details expects 201.

title: Leave request approve/reject workflow
description: GET /api/v1/leaves lists requests (200). PATCH /api/v1/leaves/:id/approve approves one (200). PATCH /api/v1/leaves/:id/reject on an already-processed request returns 200 or 409 depending on state.

title: Create schedule, shift pattern, and link employee to user
description: POST /api/v1/schedules creates a schedule (201). POST /api/v1/shift-patterns creates a pattern (201). POST /api/v1/employees/:id/link with a matching user expects 200.

title: Invalid role assignment on user
description: PATCH /api/v1/users/:id/role with a non-existent roleId expects 404 or a validation error. GET /api/v1/employees/linkable-users returns candidate users (200).

title: Expense creation and approval
description: POST /api/v1/expenses creates an expense (201). GET /api/v1/expenses lists it (200). PATCH /api/v1/expenses/:id/approve approves it (200).

title: Expense validation and not-found rejection
description: POST /api/v1/expenses with a malformed amount expects 400. PATCH /api/v1/expenses/:id/reject for a non-existent expense expects 404.

title: Coupon creation and validation
description: POST /api/v1/coupons creates a coupon (201). POST /api/v1/coupons/validate with the valid code returns 200 (valid). POST /api/v1/coupons/validate with an expired/unknown code expects 400 or 404.

title: Gift card creation and validation
description: POST /api/v1/gift-cards creates a gift card (201). POST /api/v1/gift-cards/validate with the active code returns 200 (valid). POST /api/v1/gift-cards/validate with a depleted/invalid code expects 400 or 404.

title: Reports return expected shapes
description: GET /api/v1/reports/revenue, /api/v1/reports/tax, and /api/v1/reports/recent-activity each expect 200 with the corresponding report data.

title: Payroll report requires elevated permission
description: GET /api/v1/reports/payroll called with a token lacking hr.manage permission expects 403.

title: Table open, kitchen queue, checkout flow
description: POST /api/v1/tables creates a table (201). POST /api/v1/tables/:id/open opens it (200). GET /api/v1/kitchen/orders returns the kitchen queue (200). POST /api/v1/tables/:id/checkout on an unopened table expects 409.

title: Waitlist and reservations
description: POST /api/v1/waitlist adds a customer to the waitlist (201). POST /api/v1/reservations creates a reservation (201). A second POST /api/v1/reservations with a conflicting time expects 409.

title: Tenant profile and subscription retrieval/update
description: GET /api/v1/tenant/profile expects 200. PATCH /api/v1/tenant/profile with updated business details expects 200. PATCH /api/v1/tenant/profile with an invalid payload expects 400.

title: Loyalty tier creation and subscription upgrade
description: POST /api/v1/loyalty-tiers creates a tier (201). GET /api/v1/subscriptions/current expects 200. POST /api/v1/subscriptions/upgrade without billing eligibility expects 402 or 409.

title: Notifications listing and mark-as-read
description: GET /api/v1/notifications expects 200. PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read marks one as read (200). PATCH /api/v1/notifications/read-all marks all as read (200). PATCH on a missing notification id expects 404.

title: Payments list requires permission
description: GET /api/v1/payments called with a token lacking the required permission expects 403; with a valid token expects 200.

title: Superadmin tenant lifecycle management
description: GET /api/v1/superadmin/tenants with a superadmin token expects 200. PATCH /api/v1/superadmin/tenants/:id/activate expects 200. PATCH /api/v1/superadmin/tenants/:id/deactivate for a non-existent tenant expects 404.

title: Non-superadmin token is rejected from superadmin routes
description: GET /api/v1/superadmin/tenants called with a regular tenant-scoped JWT (no superadmin role) expects 403.

title: Superadmin analytics, audit logs, queues, and health
description: GET /api/v1/superadmin/analytics/summary, /api/v1/superadmin/audit-logs, /api/v1/superadmin/queues, and /api/v1/superadmin/health each expect 200 with a superadmin token.

title: Public health and metrics endpoints
description: GET /api/v1/health and GET /api/v1/metrics are reachable without authentication and return 200.

title: Stripe webhook signature verification
description: POST /api/v1/webhooks/stripe with a valid Stripe signature expects 200 and processes the event. POST with an invalid/missing signature expects 400.

title: Cross-tenant data isolation on a scoped resource
description: Create a resource (e.g. a customer or item) under tenant A's token. Attempt to GET/PATCH/DELETE it using tenant B's token. Expect 404 (not 403) — the resource must appear to not exist rather than merely be forbidden, per project tenancy rules.

title: Low-privilege role is denied write access
description: Using a low-privilege role token (e.g. cashier) without items.manage, call POST /api/v1/items and expect 403 rather than 200/201.
